name: Peruda
overview: Peruda is a male figure identified in the Bible as a servant of Solomon. The Scripture specifically mentions him in Ezra 2:55, highlighting his role without detailing his tribal affiliation or family background. His mention is brief and focused on his service under Solomon.
namesAndTitles: The name Peruda, also spelled Perida, means 'single' or 'unique.' This proper name is not indicated as being given by God but reflects a distinctive personal name recorded in Ezra 2:55 and Nehemiah 7:57. The meaning underscores the uniqueness of the individual rather than any divine naming.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture does not record family relationships for Peruda beyond his identification as Solomon's servant. There are no additional relational details or tribal affiliations provided in the biblical text.
scriptureSignificance: Peruda's significance lies in his role as a servant of Solomon, situating him within the context of Solomon's reign and service. His mention in the post-exilic lists in Ezra and Nehemiah connects him to the community of those who returned from exile, emphasizing the continuity of service and dedication among God's people. While not a prominent figure, Peruda represents faithful service in the biblical narrative.
